jp-20261020-news-2.title: Discussions on Reforming the High-Cost Medical Expense Benefit System: How Might the Out-of-Pocket Maximum Change? Understanding the Dilemma Between Patient Group Concerns and Insurance Finances

segments.tr: ## Introduction

segments.src: 医療費が高額になったとき、家計の負担に歯止めをかけてくれるのが「高額療養費制度」です。公的医療保険の仕組みのなかでも、がんや難病などで長く治療を続ける人にとっては、生活を支える土台のような存在といえます。
segments.tr: When medical expenses become high, the "High-Cost Medical Expense Benefit System" acts as a brake on the burden on household finances. Within the framework of public medical insurance, it can be considered a foundational support for those undergoing long-term treatment for conditions such as cancer or intractable diseases.

segments.src: この制度について、現役世代の保険料負担を抑える観点から、自己負担の上限額を見直すかどうかが議論されてきました。2025年には引き上げ案が示されたものの、患者団体などから強い懸念の声が上がり、見直しの進め方そのものが問われる展開になりました。
segments.tr: Regarding this system, there has been a debate over whether to revise the maximum out-of-pocket limit from the perspective of curbing insurance premium burdens on the working generation. Although a proposal for an increase was presented in 2025, it faced strong concerns from patient groups and others, leading to a situation where the very process of how the revision is being handled has been called into question.

segments.src: この記事では、制度の基本的な仕組み、見直しで論点になる点、長期治療を続ける人への影響を、家計の目線で整理します。なお、制度の具体的な金額や適用時期は改正のたびに変わります。実際に利用する際は、加入している健康保険の窓口や厚生労働省の公式情報で最新の内容をご確認ください。
segments.tr: This article organizes the basic mechanisms of the system, the points of contention in the revision, and the impact on those continuing long-term treatment, from the perspective of household finances. Please note that the specific amounts and application timing of the system change with each revision. When actually using the system, please check the latest information at the counter of your health insurance provider or via official information from the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare.

segments.src: ## 高額療養費制度の基本的な仕組み
segments.tr: ## Basic Mechanism of the High-Cost Medical Expense Benefit System

segments.src: ### 1か月の自己負担に上限がある
segments.tr: ### There is a monthly out-of-pocket maximum

segments.src: 医療機関や薬局の窓口で支払う金額が、1か月（月の初めから終わりまで）で上限額を超えた場合、超えた分があとから払い戻される制度です。窓口で支払う自己負担は、原則として医療費の1〜3割です。ただ、入院や手術、高額な薬を使う治療では、3割負担でも大きな金額になります。この制度があることで、負担が青天井にならないようになっています。
segments.tr: This is a system where, if the amount paid at the counter of medical institutions or pharmacies exceeds a maximum limit in one month (from the beginning to the end of the month), the excess amount is reimbursed later. In principle, the out-of-pocket payment at the counter is 10% to 30% of medical expenses. However, for hospitalization, surgery, or treatment using expensive drugs, even a 30% copayment can be a large amount. This system ensures that the burden does not become limitless.

segments.src: ### 上限額は年齢と所得で決まる
segments.tr: ### The maximum limit is determined by age and income

segments.src: 上限額は、70歳未満か70歳以上か、また所得の区分によって異なります。たとえば70歳未満で年収がおおむね370万〜770万円の区分では、上限は「8万100円＋（医療費－26万7,000円）×1％」という計算式で決まる仕組みです。所得が高い区分ほど上限は高く、住民税非課税世帯では低く設定されています。
segments.tr: The maximum limit varies depending on whether you are under 70 or 70 and older, as well as your income bracket. For example, for those under 70 with an annual income of approximately 3.7 million to 7.7 million yen, the limit is determined by the formula: "80,100 yen + (Medical Expenses - 267,000 yen) × 1%". The higher the income bracket, the higher the limit, and it is set lower for households exempt from resident tax.

segments.src: ### 「多数回該当」と「限度額適用認定証」
segments.tr: ### "Multiple-Time Eligibility" and "Certificate of Maximum Amount Application"

segments.src: - **多数回該当**：直近12か月のうち、上限に達した月が3回以上になると、4回目以降は上限額がさらに下がります。長期の治療を続ける人の負担を軽くするための仕組みです。
segments.tr: - **Multiple-Time Eligibility**: If you reach the maximum limit three or more times within the last 12 months, the maximum limit is further reduced from the fourth time onwards. This is a mechanism to lighten the burden on those continuing long-term treatment.

segments.src: - **限度額適用認定証（マイナ保険証の利用を含む）**：事前に手続きをしておけば、窓口での支払いを最初から上限額までにとどめられます。いったん多額を立て替える必要がなくなり、家計の資金繰りの面で助かります。
segments.tr: - **Certificate of Maximum Amount Application (including the use of My Number health insurance cards)**: If you complete the procedures in advance, you can limit your payment at the counter to the maximum amount from the start. This eliminates the need to temporarily pay a large amount, which helps with household cash flow.
### Items not covered

segments.src: 入院時の食事代や差額ベッド代、先進医療の技術料などは、制度の対象外です。「上限があるから安心」と考えていても、実際の持ち出しは上限額より大きくなることがあります。
segments.tr: Meal costs during hospitalization, the difference in bed charges, and technical fees for advanced medical care are not covered by the system. Even if you think you are safe because there is a "maximum limit," your actual out-of-pocket expenses may be higher than that limit.

segments.src: ## なぜ見直しが議論されるのか
segments.tr: ## Why is a revision being discussed?

segments.src: 背景にあるのは、医療保険財政の厳しさです。高齢化や医療の高度化で医療費は増え続けており、高額な薬の登場も重なって、高額療養費の支給額も増加しています。その費用は保険料と公費でまかなわれるため、制度を維持するほど現役世代の保険料に影響します。
segments.tr: The background is the severity of medical insurance finances. Medical expenses continue to rise due to aging and the advancement of medical care, and with the emergence of expensive drugs, the amount paid out for high-cost medical expenses is also increasing. Since these costs are covered by insurance premiums and public funds, maintaining the system affects the insurance premiums of the working generation.

segments.src: 「保険料の上昇を抑えたい」という現役世代の立場と、「治療を続けるための負担を増やさないでほしい」という患者側の立場。どちらにも切実な事情があり、見直しの議論はこの2つの間で揺れてきました。
segments.tr: The stance of the working generation who "want to curb the rise in insurance premiums" and the stance of patients who "do not want the burden of continuing treatment to increase." Both have pressing circumstances, and the debate over the revision has swayed between these two.
## Main points of contention in the revision

segments.src: ### 1. 上限額をどの程度、どの区分で引き上げるか
segments.tr: ### 1. To what extent and in which brackets should the maximum limit be raised?

segments.src: 所得区分をより細かく分け、収入が高めの層の上限を引き上げる案が検討されてきました。区分ごとに増える金額は異なりますが、月々の上限が数千円から1万円前後動くだけでも、年間では数万円規模の差になります。治療が長期にわたる場合、その影響は積み重なります。
segments.tr: Proposals have been considered to divide income brackets more finely and raise the maximum limit for higher-income groups. Although the increased amount varies by bracket, even a change of a few thousand to around 10,000 yen in the monthly limit results in a difference of tens of thousands of yen annually. If treatment is long-term, the impact accumulates.

segments.src: ### 2. 長期治療を続ける人への配慮
segments.tr: ### 2. Consideration for those continuing long-term treatment

segments.src: 多数回該当の水準をどう扱うかが、大きな争点です。患者団体は、がんの内服治療や慢性の難病のように、何年も治療が続く人ほど影響が大きいと訴えました。これを受けて、長期療養者の負担が急に重くならないよう、据え置きや年間の上限といった緩和策を組み合わせる考え方が議論されています。
segments.tr: How to handle the level of "Multiple-Time Eligibility" is a major point of contention. Patient groups have argued that the impact is greater for those whose treatment continues for years, such as oral cancer treatment or chronic intractable diseases. In response, ideas are being discussed to combine mitigation measures, such as maintaining current levels or setting an annual maximum, so that the burden on long-term patients does not suddenly become heavy.
### 3. Decision-making procedures

segments.src: 2025年の議論では、当事者の声を十分に聞かないまま案が進んだことへの批判が出ました。その後、政府は引き上げを見送り、患者団体などの意見を聞く場を設けて再検討する流れになりました。制度の中身だけでなく、「誰の声をどう反映して決めるか」も重要な論点です。
segments.tr: In the 2025 discussions, criticism arose that the proposal proceeded without sufficiently listening to the voices of the parties involved. Subsequently, the government postponed the increase and moved toward a process of re-examination by creating opportunities to hear the opinions of patient groups and others. Not only the content of the system but also "whose voices are reflected and how decisions are made" are important points of contention.

segments.src: ## がんや難病など長期治療を続ける人への影響
segments.tr: ## Impact on those continuing long-term treatment for cancer, intractable diseases, etc.

segments.src: ### 数字で考える家計への影響
segments.tr: ### Thinking about the impact on household finances with numbers

segments.src: 仮に月々の上限額が1万円上がった場合、年間では12万円の負担増です。多数回該当の月が続く人にとっては、この上限が収入に対して占める割合は決して小さくありません。
segments.tr: If the monthly maximum limit increases by 10,000 yen, it is an annual burden increase of 120,000 yen. For those who have continuous months of "Multiple-Time Eligibility," the proportion of this limit relative to their income is by no means small.

segments.src: さらに、治療中は次のような費用も重なります。
segments.tr: Furthermore, the following costs also pile up during treatment:

segments.src: - 通院の交通費や、遠方の病院に通う場合の宿泊費
segments.tr: - Transportation costs for hospital visits and accommodation costs when visiting distant hospitals

segments.src: - 差額ベッド代、入院中の食事代
segments.tr: - Difference in bed charges, meal costs during hospitalization

segments.src: - 就労の制限や休職による収入の減少
segments.tr: - Decrease in income due to work restrictions or leave of absence

segments.src: 制度の上限だけでなく、これらを含めた「実際の持ち出し」で考えることが大切です。
segments.tr: It is important to think not only about the system's maximum limit but also about the "actual out-of-pocket expenses" including these.

segments.src: ### 治療の中断につながる懸念
segments.tr: ### Concerns about leading to treatment interruption

segments.src: 患者団体が特に心配しているのは、負担が増えることで治療を控えたり、薬の量を調整したりする人が出ることです。治療の中断が病状の悪化につながれば、結果として医療費がかさむ可能性もあります。短期的な財政の節約と、長期的な医療の質のバランスをどう取るかが問われています。
segments.tr: What patient groups are particularly worried about is that people may refrain from treatment or adjust the amount of medication due to the increased burden. If the interruption of treatment leads to a worsening of the condition, it may result in higher medical costs in the end. The question is how to balance short-term fiscal savings with long-term quality of medical care.
## Preparations you can make in your household

segments.src: 制度がどう変わるかにかかわらず、次の点を確認しておくと安心です。
segments.tr: Regardless of how the system changes, it is reassuring to check the following points:

segments.src: 1. **加入先の確認**：健康保険組合や協会けんぽには、独自の「付加給付」を設けているところがあります。上限額がさらに低くなる場合があるため、自分の保険の内容を確認しましょう。
segments.tr: 1. **Check your insurance provider**: Some health insurance associations and Kyokai Kenpo have their own "additional benefits." Since the maximum limit may be even lower, check the details of your insurance.

segments.src: 2. **限度額適用認定証やマイナ保険証の活用**：窓口での支払いを抑え、立て替えの負担を減らせます。
segments.tr: 2. **Utilize the Certificate of Maximum Amount Application or My Number health insurance card**: You can curb payments at the counter and reduce the burden of temporary payments.

segments.src: 3. **医療費控除の活用**：1年間の医療費が一定額を超えたときは、確定申告で所得税の控除を受けられる場合があります。
segments.tr: 3. **Utilize the Medical Expense Deduction**: When medical expenses for one year exceed a certain amount, you may be able to receive an income tax deduction through your tax return.

segments.src: 4. **世帯での合算**：同じ医療保険に入っている家族の自己負担は、条件を満たせば合算できます。
segments.tr: 4. **Combine expenses within the household**: Out-of-pocket expenses for family members enrolled in the same medical insurance can be combined if conditions are met.

segments.src: 5. **相談窓口の利用**：病院の医療ソーシャルワーカーや、がん相談支援センターでは、費用や制度について相談できます。
segments.tr: 5. **Use consultation services**: You can consult about costs and the system with medical social workers at hospitals or cancer consultation support centers.

segments.src: ## 民間の医療保険はどう考えるか
segments.tr: ## How to think about private medical insurance

segments.src: 公的制度の見直しに不安を感じて、民間の医療保険を検討する人もいるでしょう。ただし、保障の内容や保険料は商品によって大きく異なります。公的制度で何がカバーされ、何が自己負担として残るのかを理解したうえで、必要な保障を見極めることが大切です。不安をあおる情報だけで判断せず、複数の情報源で比較してください。
segments.tr: Some people may consider private medical insurance due to anxiety about the revision of the public system. However, the content of coverage and insurance premiums vary greatly depending on the product. It is important to understand what is covered by the public system and what remains as an out-of-pocket expense, and then identify the necessary coverage. Do not judge based only on information that stirs up anxiety; please compare using multiple sources of information.
## Points to watch in the future

segments.src: - 引き上げの有無や、その幅、所得区分の切り分け方
segments.tr: - Whether an increase will be implemented, its scope, and how income brackets will be divided

segments.src: - 長期療養者向けの緩和策（年間上限や多数回該当の扱い）の中身
segments.tr: - The content of mitigation measures for long-term patients (annual maximums and handling of Multiple-Time Eligibility)

segments.src: - 実施時期と、周知・準備の期間が十分に確保されるか
segments.tr: - Whether the implementation timing and sufficient periods for public awareness and preparation are secured

segments.src: - 当事者の意見を、制度設計にどう反映していくか
segments.tr: - How the opinions of the parties involved will be reflected in the system design
## Summary

segments.src: 高額療養費制度は、病気になったときの家計を守る「セーフティネット」です。一方で、その費用は保険料でまかなわれており、現役世代の負担とのバランスを取る必要があります。見直しをめぐる議論は、単に金額の増減だけでなく、「誰がどこまで負担を分かち合うのか」という社会の合意づくりそのものだといえます。
segments.tr: The High-Cost Medical Expense Benefit System is a "safety net" that protects household finances when you get sick. On the other hand, those costs are covered by insurance premiums, and it is necessary to balance them with the burden on the working generation. The debate surrounding the revision is not just about the increase or decrease in amounts, but can be said to be the creation of social consensus itself on "who shares the burden and to what extent."

segments.src: 制度の内容は今後も変わる可能性があります。ご自身や家族の状況に合わせて、最新の公的な情報を確認し、必要に応じて保険者や医療機関の相談窓口を利用してください。
segments.tr: The content of the system may change in the future. Please check the latest official information according to your and your family's situation, and use the consultation counters of your insurer or medical institution as needed.

segments.src: *本記事は一般的な情報提供を目的としており、特定の医療行為や金融商品を勧めるものではありません。制度の詳細は、厚生労働省や加入する医療保険者の公式発表をご確認ください。*
segments.tr: *This article is for general information purposes and does not recommend specific medical procedures or financial products. For details on the system, please check the official announcements from the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare or your medical insurance provider.*
